privacy.whatWeCollectIntro: When you create an account or place an order, we collect:
privacy.collectPhone: Phone number (so we can reach you about your order)
privacy.collectOrders: Order history and loyalty points balance
privacy.whyDeliver: To deliver your orders to the correct address
privacy.whyContact: To contact you if there is an issue with your order
privacy.whyPoints: To manage your loyalty points and rewards
privacy.whyImprove: To improve our service and product selection
privacy.sharingDesc: We do not sell or share your personal information with any third parties. Your data is only accessible to us as the store operator.

privacy.retentionDesc: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. Order records are kept for bookkeeping purposes as required by Swedish law. If you delete your account, your personal data will be removed.
